candidates.title: Scientists rediscover ancient Roman color-changing glass magic
candidates.description: Researchers have finally decoded the optical engineering behind the 1,600-year-old Lycurgus Cup, which changes color from jade green to red depending on the light source.

candidates.title: Pennsylvania becomes first US state to label AI-generated ads
candidates.description: Governor Josh Shapiro signed a law requiring clear disclosures on any ad significantly modified or generated by AI, setting a precedent for digital transparency.

candidates.title: Antarctic postmaster shares life among noisy penguins
candidates.description: George Clarke takes on the unique role of running the post office at Port Lockroy, interacting with local penguin colonies during the Antarctic summer season.

candidates.title: Gen Z defies trends by buying Y2K cars they can fix themselves
candidates.description: Young Americans are choosing no-frills, affordable used cars over expensive new SUVs, embracing DIY repairs and cash purchases to avoid steep loans.

candidates.title: Handmade leather firm refuses robots to keep craftsmanship alive
candidates.description: A historic Walsall factory continues to handmake wallets and cigar cases, proving that attention to detail and human skill remain vital in high-end manufacturing.

candidates.title: Swiss ski resort Laax leads the way in 'greenstyling' the Alps
candidates.description: Facing climate challenges, Laax implements electric piste-grooming, chemical-free snow cannons, and on-demand gondolas to create a sustainable future for winter sports.

candidates.title: Norfolk couple wins landmark battles to protect rare wetland
candidates.description: After more than a decade of fighting environmental regulators, a farming couple scored three legal victories to save Catfield Fen, a crucial habitat in the Norfolk Broads.

candidates.title: Lara Croft turns 30: A look back at Tomb Raider's iconic journey
candidates.description: Celebrating three decades since her debut, we revisit the highlights and lowlights of the video game icon who sold over 100 million games worldwide.

candidates.title: LG C6 OLED TV drops $400 early ahead of Black Friday
candidates.description: Shoppers can now snag a significant discount on the highly-rated LG C6 OLED TV and soundbars, with sales running through November 1st.
